data.label: Existing IAM operator
data.description: Existing IAM principal outside the provisioning scope. Uploads, reads and deletes test documents. ARN supplied as a reviewable input and never stored in the diagram.

data.label: Private test document bucket
data.description: Private S3 bucket for synthetic text documents. Block Public Access is on, server-side encryption and versioning are enabled, and the bucket policy grants access only to the named operator.

brief.application: I need a private place on AWS to store a small set of synthetic text documents for a deployment test. Keep public access blocked and enable encryption and versioning. This first scenario only needs storage; no AI, database or web application. An existing IAM operator needs upload, read and delete access. Draw the caller and its explicit scoped access contract. Do not deploy.

lastAsked.question: What kinds of documents arrive, and how many a month?
lastAsked.beginner: For example “invoices, about 3,000 a month, mostly PDF”.
lastAsked.why: It shapes the Document extraction design.

requirements.statement: Proposed: the test bucket blocks all public access and enables server-side encryption and object versioning.
requirements.rationale: Stops accidental public exposure and allows recovery of overwritten objects.
requirements.basis: "Keep public access blocked and enable encryption and versioning."

requirements.statement: Proposed: only the existing IAM operator can upload, read and delete objects. No other principal gets access, and delete coverage must be confirmed in the typed contract.
requirements.rationale: An explicit least-privilege contract avoids broad grants. Unconfirmed delete permission could cause failures during test cleanup.
requirements.basis: "An existing IAM operator needs upload, read and delete access."

requirements.statement: Proposed: this first scenario covers storage only and excludes AI, databases and web applications. Nothing is deployed from this design.
requirements.rationale: Clear limits keep the deployment test small and reviewable.
requirements.basis: "This first scenario only needs storage; no AI, database or web application." and "Do not deploy."

decisions.subject: design.private-s3-test-bucket-with-scoped-existing-operator-access
decisions.title: Private S3 test bucket with scoped existing-operator access
decisions.context: Scope: one proposed private Amazon S3 bucket (Block Public Access, server-side encryption, versioning) for synthetic text documents, plus the existing IAM operator as an external caller with one s3-read-write access contract. No AI, database or web app. Assumptions: region not yet selected; operator ARN supplied later as a Terraform input; identity not verified; delete permission must be confirmed against the s3-read-write contract. No deployment.
decisions.decision: Drawn while talking as design revision 2.
